questions.stem: Why is high pressure created in the glomerulus?

options.text: Because the glomerulus is surrounded by a thick capsule
Because the heart pumps blood very quickly through the kidneys
Because the renal vein has valves that restrict blood flow
Because the afferent arteriole is wider than the efferent arteriole

questions.explanation: The afferent (incoming) arteriole has a wider diameter than the efferent (outgoing) arteriole. This means blood enters faster than it can leave, building up pressure in the glomerulus and forcing filtrate out.
